# Fate UI v0.8.10-beta6

Switching back to a folder whose agent is already running is now instant and never blanks its session list. Every folder's agent stays alive.

## Always-on folder agents + instant switching

- **Every open folder keeps its Pi agent running.** Idle eviction is disabled, so a folder you opened stays ready (the hard concurrency cap still reclaims the oldest slot only if you open many folders at once). This is the "run an agent per folder" behavior: correctness first, tuning later.
- **Re-opening a folder with a live runtime now takes the fast path.** It re-focuses the existing agent and returns its current state immediately, instead of flashing an empty "No sessions yet" preview and reloading all sessions from disk. Switching between `piagent-fategui` (190 sessions) and `ethereal_porezna` no longer makes the big list vanish and reload.
- The sidebar uses the cached session list whenever the focused folder's in-memory list is momentarily empty (preview/initializing), so the list you were looking at stays on screen.

## Compatibility and installers

No migration is needed. Existing projects, Pi sessions, settings, themes, and folder history are unchanged.

GitHub Actions builds and tests this release on Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, and Linux x64. The prerelease contains installers plus `SHA256SUMS`:

- Windows x64: NSIS `.exe`
- macOS arm64 and x64: `.dmg` and `.pkg`
- Linux x64: `.AppImage` and `.deb`

Public beta installers remain unsigned. Windows SmartScreen or macOS Gatekeeper may show an unknown-publisher warning. Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS`.
